summary: Frontend visual parity test of PaymentDetail and DepositDetail vs reference PlanDetail. All three detail pages now use identical structure: 'Terug' pill with text + left arrow, hoofdcard with tenant name h1 + Appt subtitle + badges + right BETAALD/BORG label with amount, followed by sub-cards (Betaalgegevens/Borggegevens + optional Gekoppelde factuur + Acties). Tested login → Betalingsregelingen → PlanDetail → screenshot. Betalingen list (had to go back 2 months to find data) → PaymentDetail → verified all elements → Terug regression works. Borg → DepositDetail → verified structure → Terug returns to list. All Actie buttons present (PDF, Verstuur, Beveiligd, Verwijder for payments; PDF bewijs, Verwijder for deposits).
critical_code_review_comments: Payments.jsx is 1290 lines - consider splitting PaymentDetail/PaymentForm/PendingApprovalModal into separate files for maintainability.
PaymentDetail fetches ALL invoices via GET /api/invoices just to find the linked one; consider a dedicated GET /api/invoices/{id} endpoint to avoid full-list fetch on each detail view.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PaymentDetail and DepositDetail visually match PlanDetail with Terug pill (text 'Terug' + left arrow) + hoofdcard + sub-cards. Note: Payments list defaults to current month (August 2026, empty in seed). To open a payment detail, click prev-month chevron 2x to reach June 2026, then click a payment-row-* element. Only PaymentDetail with a linked invoice shows the 'Gekoppelde factuur' progress card; sample row tested did not have one.
